words.enDefinition: The membrane-bound compartment that contains most of the DNA in a human cell that has a nucleus.

examples.en: The cell nucleus is shaded purple in the model of a typical human skin cell.
examples.zh: 典型人类皮肤细胞模型中，「细胞核」用紫色表示。

examples.en: We identified the cell nucleus before looking at how chromosomes are arranged in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「细胞核」，再看示意图中染色体如何排列。

words.enDefinition: The complete set of genetic material in a cell or organism.

examples.en: The genome diagram includes genetic material in the nucleus and in the mitochondria in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「基因组」示意图包含细胞核和线粒体中的遗传物质。

examples.en: We read the genome diagram by following the labels from the whole set to individual chromosomes.
examples.zh: 我们沿着标签，从整套遗传物质看到各条染色体，以读懂「基因组」图。

words.enDefinition: The set of genetic material located in the nucleus of a cell.

examples.en: The nuclear genome is represented by the chromosomes drawn inside the nucleus in our cell diagram.
examples.zh: 在细胞示意图中，细胞核内所画的染色体代表「核基因组」。

examples.en: We distinguished the nuclear genome from the small set of genetic material inside mitochondria in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「核基因组」与线粒体内少量遗传物质区分开。

words.enDefinition: The complex of DNA and associated proteins that makes up chromosomes in the cell nucleus.

examples.en: The chromatin is shown loosely arranged in the classroom diagram of the cell between divisions.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，细胞处于两次分裂之间时，「染色质」画得较为疏松。

examples.en: We compared the appearance of chromatin in the two labelled panels of the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们比较教材图中两个已标注小图里的「染色质」外观。

words.enDefinition: A structure of DNA and associated proteins that carries genetic information.

examples.en: The chromosome is drawn separately so the class can identify both arms and the central junction.
examples.zh: 图中单独画出一条「染色体」，方便全班辨认两条臂和中间连接处。

examples.en: We matched each chromosome in the classroom illustration with its counterpart in the paired view.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂图示中每条「染色体」与成对视图中的对应染色体配对。

words.enDefinition: Two corresponding chromosomes with the same basic arrangement of gene loci, one from each parent in a typical human pair.

examples.en: The homologous chromosomes carry the same labelled loci even though some allele symbols differ in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「同源染色体」带有同样的标记位点，某些等位基因符号则不同。

examples.en: We paired the homologous chromosomes by comparing their lengths and corresponding markings on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂图上各条染色体的长度及相应标记，以配对「同源染色体」。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome other than a sex chromosome.

examples.en: The autosome in the figure belongs to one of the numbered pairs in the human set.
examples.zh: 图中的「常染色体」属于人类染色体中用数字编号的某一对。

examples.en: We identified the autosome before reading the separate labels for the sex chromosomes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先辨认这条「常染色体」，再读性染色体单独的标签。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome involved in chromosomal sex determination, such as X or Y in humans.

examples.en: The diagram labels each sex chromosome separately from the numbered autosomal pairs in the teaching example.
examples.zh: 教学示例图将每条「性染色体」与编号的常染色体对分开标注。

examples.en: We found the sex chromosome labels at the end of the arranged human chromosome chart.
examples.zh: 我们在排好的人类染色体图末尾找到了标注「性染色体」的标签。

words.enDefinition: One complete set of chromosomes, including one chromosome of each autosome type and a sex chromosome in a typical human gamete.

examples.en: The worksheet shows one chromosome set with one of each autosome type and one sex chromosome.
examples.zh: 练习用每种常染色体各一条，再加一条性染色体，展示一套「染色体组」。

examples.en: We counted each chromosome set before labelling the classroom cells as haploid or diploid.
examples.zh: 我们先数出各细胞模型的「染色体组」数，再标上单倍体或二倍体。

words.enDefinition: The number of complete sets of chromosomes in a cell.

examples.en: The ploidy stays the same after the chromosomes are copied in this classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，染色体复制后，「倍性」保持不变。

examples.en: We checked ploidy by counting sets instead of counting the chromatids drawn in the model.
examples.zh: 我们通过数染色体组来核对「倍性」，而不是数模型上的染色单体。

words.enDefinition: A cell with one complete set of chromosomes.

examples.en: The haploid cell is drawn with only one complete set of chromosomes in the lesson.
examples.zh: 课上所画的「单倍体细胞」中只有一套完整的染色体。

examples.en: We identified a haploid cell by counting one set of chromosomes on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中数到一套染色体，因此认出这是「单倍体细胞」。

words.enDefinition: A cell with two complete sets of chromosomes.

examples.en: The diploid cell contains a pair of homologues for each autosome in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的「二倍体细胞」含有各种常染色体各自的一对同源染色体。

examples.en: We compared the diploid cell with the model of a cell containing one set.
examples.zh: 我们将「二倍体细胞」与只有一套染色体的细胞模型进行比较。

collocations: chromosome sets of a diploid cell

words.enDefinition: A body cell outside the reproductive germ line.

examples.en: The worksheet uses a skin cell as an example of a typical human somatic cell.
examples.zh: 练习用皮肤细胞作为一种典型人类「体细胞」的示例。

examples.en: We compared the chromosome sets in a somatic cell and a gamete in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂图中一个「体细胞」与一个配子的染色体组。

words.enDefinition: A cell in the lineage that develops into eggs or sperm, including a gamete in broad usage.

examples.en: The germ cell is identified by its position on the reproductive cell lineage diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上根据细胞在生殖细胞谱系图中的位置，将它认作「生殖系细胞」。

examples.en: We traced the germ cell through the stages shown in the simplified textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们沿简化教材图各阶段查看「生殖系细胞」的变化。

words.enDefinition: A reproductive cell carrying one chromosome set that can unite with another such cell at fertilization.

examples.en: The gamete carries one set of chromosomes in the simplified human inheritance diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化的人类遗传图中，「配子」带有一套染色体。

examples.en: We marked each gamete before combining the chromosome sets in the fictional worksheet example.
examples.zh: 在虚构练习中，我们先标出每个「配子」，再合并它们携带的染色体组。

words.enDefinition: The cell formed when two gametes unite, normally restoring two chromosome sets in humans.

examples.en: The zygote contains both chromosome sets in the first panel of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图第一幅小图中的「合子」含有两套染色体。

examples.en: We counted the labelled chromosome sets in the zygote before reading the next panel.
examples.zh: 我们先数「合子」中标出的染色体组，再看下一幅图。

words.enDefinition: The number and appearance of chromosomes in a cell, also used for a display of that complement.

examples.en: The karyotype describes the chromosome complement that the worksheet illustrates with an arranged set of images.
examples.zh: 「核型」描述练习用排列好的图像所展示的染色体组合。

examples.en: We used the karyotype label to identify the chromosome count shown in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们根据「核型」标签辨认虚构示例中显示的染色体数目。

words.enDefinition: An ordered display of chromosome images typically arranged in matched pairs by size and appearance.

examples.en: The karyogram places corresponding chromosomes side by side in the rearranged classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂重新排列的图示中，「染色体核型图」把相应染色体并排摆放。

examples.en: We located the pair numbered two on the karyogram drawn for the teaching exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在教学练习画出的「染色体核型图」中找到标为二的一对。

words.enDefinition: The two replicated copies of a chromosome that remain joined until they separate during division.

examples.en: The sister chromatids are drawn as two adjoining copies of one chromosome in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「姐妹染色单体」画成同一条染色体彼此相连的两个副本。

examples.en: We traced the sister chromatids after the model shows each copy moving to a different side.
examples.zh: 模型展示两个副本分别移向两侧时，我们继续追踪原先的「姐妹染色单体」。

words.enDefinition: Chromatids belonging to different homologous chromosomes rather than to the same replicated chromosome.

examples.en: The nonsister chromatids are coloured differently because they belong to different homologues in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「非姐妹染色单体」属于不同的同源染色体，因此用不同颜色表示。

examples.en: We pointed to nonsister chromatids on the paired chromosome model before reading the crossing diagram.
examples.zh: 查看交叉图前，我们先在配对染色体模型上指出「非姐妹染色单体」。

words.enDefinition: A specialized region of a chromosome that helps hold sister chromatids together and organizes their attachment during division.

examples.en: The centromere is marked at the narrow region where the sister chromatids meet in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中在姐妹染色单体相接的狭窄处标出了「着丝粒」。

examples.en: We checked the position of the centromere before identifying the longer arm of the example chromosome.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「着丝粒」的位置，再指出示例染色体较长的臂。

words.enDefinition: A protective structure containing repetitive DNA and proteins at the end of a linear chromosome.

examples.en: The telomere is highlighted at the chromosome tip in the labelled drawing for class.
examples.zh: 课堂带标注的图把「端粒」突出画在染色体末端。

examples.en: We labelled the telomere separately from the narrow region near the middle of the chromosome.
examples.zh: 我们把「端粒」与染色体中部附近的狭窄区域分别标注。

words.enDefinition: A section of a chromosome extending from the centromere to an end.

examples.en: Each chromosome arm is marked from the constricted region to the tip on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图将每条「染色体臂」标为从缢缩部位到末端的一段。

examples.en: We compared the two ends before putting a label on each chromosome arm in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先比较两端，再为各条「染色体臂」添加标签。

words.enDefinition: The shorter arm of a chromosome, conventionally designated p in human chromosome notation.

examples.en: The short arm of a chromosome is labelled with a lowercase letter on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图用一个小写字母标出「染色体短臂」。

examples.en: We pointed to the short arm of a chromosome before locating the indicated band on it.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「染色体短臂」，再在上面找到所指的区带。

collocations: label the short arm of a chromosome
band on the short arm of a chromosome
identify the short arm of a chromosome

words.enDefinition: The longer arm of a chromosome, conventionally designated q in human chromosome notation.

examples.en: The long arm of a chromosome extends farther from the centromere in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「染色体长臂」从着丝粒向外延伸得更远。

examples.en: We read the label for the long arm of a chromosome before comparing its bands.
examples.zh: 我们先读「染色体长臂」的标签，再比较其区带。

collocations: identify the long arm of a chromosome
band on the long arm of a chromosome
label the long arm of a chromosome

words.enDefinition: A distinguishable region in the patterned appearance of a chromosome on a prepared image or diagram.

examples.en: The chromosome band is marked as a dark strip in the supplied teaching image.
examples.zh: 给定的教学图像把「染色体区带」标为一条深色条纹。

examples.en: We used the chromosome band labels to match the marked regions in two textbook figures.
examples.zh: 我们根据「染色体区带」标签，对应两幅教材图中的标记区域。

words.enDefinition: A basic chromatin unit in which a segment of DNA is wrapped around histone proteins.

examples.en: The nucleosome appears as a small rounded unit in the enlarged chromatin model for class.
examples.zh: 课堂放大的染色质模型把「核小体」画成小圆形单位。

examples.en: We pointed to each nucleosome before identifying the thread joining the units in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们先指出各个「核小体」，再辨认图中连接这些单位的细线。

words.enDefinition: A protein around which nuclear DNA is organized as part of chromatin.

examples.en: The histone is represented by a coloured shape inside the simplified chromatin diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化染色质图里，一个彩色形状代表「组蛋白」。

examples.en: We distinguished the histone from the strand that wraps around the group of proteins.
examples.zh: 我们把「组蛋白」与缠绕在这组蛋白质周围的细链区分开。

words.enDefinition: The compaction of chromatin into more tightly packed and distinct chromosomes during cell division.

examples.en: Chromosome condensation makes individual chromosomes more distinct in the staged diagrams used in our lesson.
examples.zh: 课上按阶段展示的图中，「染色体凝缩」使各条染色体更容易区分。

examples.en: We compared two panels showing different degrees of chromosome condensation in the teaching figure.
examples.zh: 我们比较教学图中「染色体凝缩」程度不同的两幅小图。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome consisting of two sister chromatids after its DNA has been copied.

examples.en: The replicated chromosome is still counted as one chromosome in this panel of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂图的这幅小图里，「已复制的染色体」仍计为一条染色体。

examples.en: We labelled the two chromatids of the replicated chromosome before comparing it with the earlier stage.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「已复制的染色体」的两个染色单体，再将它与较早阶段比较。

collocations: two chromatids of a replicated chromosome

words.enDefinition: The count of distinct chromosomes in a cell, treating a joined pair of sister chromatids as one chromosome before separation.

examples.en: The chromosome number remains unchanged while sister copies are still joined in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，姐妹副本仍相连时，「染色体数目」保持不变。

examples.en: We recorded the chromosome number beside the stage shown in the simplified cell division chart.
examples.zh: 我们在简化细胞分裂图的对应阶段旁记录了「染色体数目」。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome whose centromere is near the middle, giving two arms of approximately equal length.

examples.en: The metacentric chromosome has arms of similar length in the classroom set of example drawings.
examples.zh: 课堂所用示例图中，「中着丝粒染色体」的两条臂长度相近。

examples.en: We chose the metacentric chromosome by comparing the position of the constriction in each image.
examples.zh: 我们比较各图中缢缩部位的位置，选出「中着丝粒染色体」。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome with an off-centre centromere and arms of noticeably different lengths.

examples.en: The submetacentric chromosome has one noticeably longer arm in the simplified diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化图上的「亚中着丝粒染色体」有一条明显较长的臂。

examples.en: We compared a submetacentric chromosome with the example whose two arms are approximately equal in length.
examples.zh: 我们将「亚中着丝粒染色体」与两条臂长度大致相等的示例作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome whose centromere lies close to one end, leaving a much shorter arm.

examples.en: The acrocentric chromosome has a short stub above the marked constriction in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「近端着丝粒染色体」在标出的缢缩部位上方只有很短一段。

examples.en: We identified an acrocentric chromosome by checking the centromere position on the supplied textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们查看给定教材图上的着丝粒位置，认出一条「近端着丝粒染色体」。

collocations: short arm of an acrocentric chromosome

words.enDefinition: Nuclear division that separates replicated chromosomes into daughter nuclei typically retaining the original chromosome number.

examples.en: The mitosis diagram shows each replicated chromosome separating into two daughter copies in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂「有丝分裂」图展示各条已复制染色体分开，两个副本分别进入子细胞核。

examples.en: We compared mitosis with the division that reduces chromosome set number in the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们把教材图中的「有丝分裂」与使染色体组数减半的分裂作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A division process with one chromosome replication followed by two divisions that reduce the number of chromosome sets.

examples.en: The meiosis overview shows two divisions after the chromosomes have been copied in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂「减数分裂」总图展示染色体复制后发生两次分裂。

examples.en: We traced the chromosome sets through meiosis in the simplified diagram used for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习用的示意图中，追踪「减数分裂」过程中的染色体组。

words.enDefinition: The first meiotic division, in which homologous chromosomes separate and chromosome set number is reduced.

examples.en: Meiosis I separates the homologous chromosomes while each remains composed of two sister chromatids in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「减数第一次分裂」分开同源染色体，而每条仍由两条姐妹染色单体组成。

examples.en: We counted the remaining sets after meiosis I in the simplified two-pair chromosome model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的两对染色体模型中，数出「减数第一次分裂」后剩余的染色体组数。

words.enDefinition: The second meiotic division, in which sister chromatids separate without an intervening round of chromosome replication.

examples.en: Meiosis II separates the sister chromatids in the final two panels of the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 课堂图的最后两幅小图中，「减数第二次分裂」使姐妹染色单体分离。

examples.en: We marked each chromosome copy after meiosis II in the fictional classroom model of human cells.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构的人类细胞课堂模型中，标出「减数第二次分裂」后的各条染色体副本。

words.enDefinition: The first stage of meiosis I, when chromosomes condense, homologues pair, and crossing over can occur.

examples.en: The homologous chromosomes pair during prophase I in the simplified diagram shown in our lesson.
examples.zh: 课上所示简图中，同源染色体在「减数第一次分裂前期」配对。

examples.en: We identified prophase I by locating the paired homologues in the classroom set of figures.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂组图中找到已配对的同源染色体，以辨认「减数第一次分裂前期」。

words.enDefinition: The meiotic stage when homologous chromosome pairs align near the middle of the cell.

examples.en: The homologous chromosome pairs line up across the middle of the model during metaphase I.
examples.zh: 模型中，各对同源染色体在「减数第一次分裂中期」排列于细胞中间。

examples.en: We compared the orientation of two pairs during metaphase I in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示中比较两对染色体在「减数第一次分裂中期」的朝向。

words.enDefinition: The meiotic stage when homologous chromosomes move apart while sister chromatids generally remain joined.

examples.en: The homologues move toward opposite sides during anaphase I in the staged classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂分阶段图中，同源染色体在「减数第一次分裂后期」移向相反两侧。

examples.en: We traced its two joined chromatids as one chromosome moves during anaphase I in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪一条染色体在「减数第一次分裂后期」移动时仍相连的两条染色单体。

words.enDefinition: The end stage of meiosis I, when separated homologues reach opposite sides of the dividing cell.

examples.en: The telophase I panel shows a separated chromosome set at each side of the simple model.
examples.zh: 「减数第一次分裂末期」小图显示，简化模型两侧各有一组分开的染色体。

examples.en: We checked which chromosome sets are shown at telophase I before looking at the next division.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「减数第一次分裂末期」所示各套染色体，再看下一次分裂。

collocations: compare telophase I with earlier stages

words.enDefinition: The stage preceding chromosome alignment in meiosis II, when a new division apparatus forms in each cell.

examples.en: The prophase II illustration shows each cell preparing for a second division in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「减数第二次分裂前期」示意图显示课堂模型中各细胞在为第二次分裂做准备。

examples.en: We compared prophase II with the earlier stage that showed homologues pairing in the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们把「减数第二次分裂前期」与教材中较早的同源染色体配对阶段作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The stage when individual replicated chromosomes align in each cell before sister chromatids separate.

examples.en: The individual chromosomes line up in the middle during metaphase II in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型里，各条染色体在「减数第二次分裂中期」排列在细胞中央。

examples.en: We distinguished metaphase II from the stage showing paired homologues in the earlier division.
examples.zh: 我们把「减数第二次分裂中期」与较早那次分裂中显示同源染色体成对排列的阶段区分开。

words.enDefinition: The stage when sister chromatids separate and move toward opposite sides of the cell.

examples.en: The sister chromatids separate during anaphase II in the final division shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸显示的最后一次分裂中，姐妹染色单体在「减数第二次分裂后期」分离。

examples.en: We followed the two copies moving apart during anaphase II on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上追踪「减数第二次分裂后期」两个副本分开移动的过程。

words.enDefinition: The final meiotic stage, when separated chromosomes reach opposite ends and new nuclei can form.

examples.en: The telophase II panel shows the chromosomes grouped at opposite sides in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂图的「减数第二次分裂末期」小图显示染色体分组位于相反两侧。

examples.en: We compared the chromosome groups at telophase II with those after the first division.
examples.zh: 我们比较「减数第二次分裂末期」的染色体分组与第一次分裂后的情况。

words.enDefinition: The period before meiosis I that includes copying DNA before the two divisions.

examples.en: The premeiotic interphase comes before both divisions in the timeline on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的时间轴中，「减数分裂前间期」位于两次分裂之前。

examples.en: We marked chromosome copying during premeiotic interphase on the simple stage diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂阶段简图上标出了「减数分裂前间期」发生的染色体复制。

words.enDefinition: The close pairing of homologous chromosomes during prophase I of meiosis.

examples.en: The diagram shows synapsis as two homologous chromosomes coming together in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂示意模型用两条同源染色体彼此靠拢表示「联会」。

examples.en: We labelled synapsis before following what happens to the paired chromosomes in the next panel.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「联会」，再查看下一幅小图里成对染色体的变化。

words.enDefinition: A protein structure that forms between paired homologous chromosomes during meiotic prophase.

examples.en: The synaptonemal complex is drawn between the paired homologues in the enlarged textbook figure.
examples.zh: 教材放大图把「联会复合体」画在配对的同源染色体之间。

examples.en: We matched the synaptonemal complex label to the structure connecting the two aligned chromosome axes.
examples.zh: 我们把「联会复合体」标签与连接两条已对齐染色体轴的结构配对。

words.enDefinition: A paired set of two replicated homologous chromosomes containing four chromatids in total.

examples.en: The tetrad is drawn with four distinguishable chromatids in the enlarged classroom diagram for this example.
examples.zh: 这个示例的课堂放大图把「四分体」画成四条可区分的染色单体。

examples.en: We counted the chromatids in a tetrad before labelling the two homologues in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先数「四分体」中的染色单体，再标出两条同源染色体。

words.enDefinition: The reciprocal exchange of corresponding chromosome segments between nonsister chromatids of homologous chromosomes during meiosis.

examples.en: Crossing over is represented by two matching segments changing places in the coloured classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂彩色图用两个对应区段互换位置表示「交叉互换」。

examples.en: We compared the chromosome colours before and after crossing over in the supplied teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们比较给定教学图中「交叉互换」前后的染色体颜色。

words.enDefinition: A point where homologous chromosomes remain visibly connected following an exchange between nonsister chromatids.

examples.en: The chiasma is marked where the chromosomes still appear connected in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图在两条染色体看起来仍相连的位置标出「交叉点」。

examples.en: We identified a chiasma on the paired chromosome diagram before following the separated homologues.
examples.zh: 我们先在配对染色体图上认出一处「交叉点」，再查看分离后的同源染色体。

words.enDefinition: A structure of microtubules that organizes chromosome movement during meiotic division.

examples.en: The meiotic spindle is shown as lines extending toward the chromosomes in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「减数分裂纺锤体」画成向染色体延伸的线。

examples.en: We labelled each end of the meiotic spindle before looking at the aligned chromosome pairs.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「减数分裂纺锤体」的两端，再观察排好序的染色体对。

words.enDefinition: The independent distribution of different chromosome pairs during meiosis, leading alleles at unlinked loci to segregate independently.

examples.en: The diagram illustrates independent assortment by showing two ways that different chromosome pairs can line up.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同染色体对的两种排列方式说明「自由组合」。

examples.en: We used independent assortment for two loci on different chromosomes in the simplified worksheet model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化练习模型中，对位于不同染色体上的两个位点应用「自由组合」。

words.enDefinition: The separation of paired alleles into different gametes as their chromosome copies are distributed during meiosis.

examples.en: The diagram shows allele segregation when the two labelled copies end up in separate model gametes.
examples.zh: 两份带标记的副本分别进入不同模型配子时，图中展示的是「等位基因分离」。

examples.en: We traced allele segregation by matching the symbols from each chromosome to the final panel.
examples.zh: 我们把各条染色体的符号对应到最后一幅图，追踪「等位基因分离」。

words.enDefinition: Failure of homologous chromosomes or sister chromatids to separate as expected during cell division.

examples.en: The nondisjunction diagram shows two labelled chromosome copies moving to the same side in the simplified model.
examples.zh: 简化模型的「不分离」图显示，两份带标记的染色体副本移到同一侧。

examples.en: We counted the copies in both resulting model cells after nondisjunction in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们数出练习中发生「不分离」后两个模型细胞各自的副本数。

words.enDefinition: A region of DNA whose information contributes to making a functional RNA or protein product.

examples.en: The gene is shown as one labelled region on the simplified chromosome drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂染色体简图把「基因」画成一个有标签的区域。

examples.en: We pointed to the gene before reading the two symbolic forms assigned in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「基因」，再看练习为它指定的两种符号形式。

words.enDefinition: A specific position on a chromosome or in a genome where a genetic feature is located.

examples.en: The genetic locus appears at the same marked position on both homologues in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，两条同源染色体的「遗传位点」出现在同一个标记位置。

examples.en: We recorded the genetic locus before comparing the two allele symbols on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先记下「遗传位点」，再比较图上两个等位基因符号。

words.enDefinition: One of the alternative forms of a gene or genetic sequence at a particular locus.

examples.en: The allele is represented by a letter in the simple inheritance table for the class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化遗传表用一个字母表示「等位基因」。

examples.en: We compared each allele at the marked locus using the symbolic chromosome diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用符号染色体图比较标记位点上的各个「等位基因」。

words.enDefinition: The genetic makeup at a specified locus or set of loci, or more broadly across an individual.

examples.en: The genotype is recorded as two allele symbols for each fictional person in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，每个虚构人物的「基因型」用两个等位基因符号记录。

examples.en: We copied the genotype from the allele column before describing the modelled visible feature.
examples.zh: 我们先从等位基因一栏抄下「基因型」，再描述模型中可观察到的特征。

words.enDefinition: An observable characteristic resulting from genetic effects, environmental effects, or their interaction.

examples.en: The phenotype is the observable feature recorded for each fictional person on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，「表型」是为各虚构人物记录的可观察特征。

examples.en: We kept the phenotype in a different column from the allele symbols in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「表型」和等位基因符号放在不同的列中。

words.enDefinition: Having two matching alleles at a specified locus in a diploid organism.

examples.en: The genotype is homozygous because both allele symbols match at the marked classroom locus.
examples.zh: 课堂标记位点上的两个等位基因符号相同，因此其基因型是「纯合的」。

examples.en: We selected the homozygous example before comparing it with the pair of unlike symbols.
examples.zh: 我们先选出「纯合的」示例，再与符号不同的一对做比较。

words.enDefinition: Having two different alleles at a specified locus in a diploid organism.

examples.en: The genotype is heterozygous because the two allele symbols are different in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 在虚构示例中，两个等位基因符号不同，所以该基因型是「杂合的」。

examples.en: We marked the heterozygous entry on the worksheet and checked both allele symbols in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们标出练习纸中「杂合的」一项，并核对两个等位基因符号。

words.enDefinition: Having only one copy of a locus in a context where paired copies often occur.

examples.en: The example labels the locus hemizygous because only one copy is shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示例把位点标成「半合的」，因为图中只有一份副本。

examples.en: We compared a hemizygous state with the two copies shown for another fictional locus.
examples.zh: 我们把「半合的」状态与另一虚构位点所示的两份副本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Having two different variants in the same gene, one on each homologous copy.

examples.en: The diagram describes this genotype as compound heterozygous because the two copies carry different labelled variants.
examples.zh: 图中的两份同源副本带有不同标记变异，因此将该基因型描述为「复合杂合的」。

examples.en: We marked the compound heterozygous example before comparing the positions of its two variants.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「复合杂合的」示例，再比较其中两个变异的位置。

words.enDefinition: The relative proportions of different genotype categories expected or observed in a stated group.

examples.en: The genotypic ratio summarises the different allele pairs in the fictional worksheet table for our class.
examples.zh: 「基因型比例」概括课堂虚构练习表中不同的等位基因配对。

examples.en: We calculated the genotypic ratio before combining entries with the same observable feature in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们先算「基因型比例」，再归并具有同样可观察特征的项目。

words.enDefinition: The relative proportions of different observable trait categories in a stated group.

examples.en: The phenotypic ratio groups the fictional entries by visible feature in the classroom inheritance table.
examples.zh: 「表型比例」在课堂遗传表中按可见特征归类各虚构项目。

examples.en: We compared the phenotypic ratio with the distribution of genotype labels in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「表型比例」与练习里基因型标签的分布作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The transmission of genetic material and its variants from parents to offspring.

examples.en: The lesson illustrates genetic inheritance by tracing symbolic chromosome copies across two fictional generations.
examples.zh: 课程通过追踪两代虚构人物的染色体副本符号，说明「遗传传递」。

examples.en: We used the family diagram to discuss genetic inheritance of the labelled example alleles.
examples.zh: 我们用家系图讨论示例中带标签等位基因的「遗传传递」。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic influenced by genetic variants transmitted from one or both parents.

examples.en: The worksheet labels the modelled feature an inherited trait under its stated genetic assumptions.
examples.zh: 在给定遗传假设下，练习将模型中的特征标为「遗传性状」。

examples.en: We followed an inherited trait through three generations of the fictional family in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪虚构家系三代中的一项「遗传性状」。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic that develops through experience or environmental influence during an individual's lifetime.

examples.en: The class discussed an acquired trait using the simple example of learning a new skill.
examples.zh: 全班用学会一项新技能这个例子讨论「后天获得性状」。

examples.en: We compared an acquired trait with a characteristic labelled as inherited in the fictional worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「后天获得性状」与虚构练习中标为遗传的特征作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance described by Mendel's rules for segregation and assortment of alleles, often illustrated with single-gene traits.

examples.en: The classroom model uses Mendelian inheritance to explain how its single labelled locus is transmitted.
examples.zh: 课堂模型用「孟德尔遗传」说明模型中单个标记位点如何传给下一代。

examples.en: We checked the assumptions of Mendelian inheritance before reading the expected categories in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「孟德尔遗传」的假设，再看练习中的预期类别。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic whose inheritance is governed primarily by variation in one gene.

examples.en: The exercise uses a single-gene trait so the class can follow one locus through the diagram.
examples.zh: 练习使用一种「单基因性状」，使全班可沿图追踪一个位点。

examples.en: We labelled the fictional single-gene trait before comparing its two observable categories in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出虚构的「单基因性状」，再比较两种可观察类别。

words.enDefinition: A grid combining possible parental alleles to show expected offspring genotype proportions under stated assumptions.

examples.en: The Punnett square lists the allele symbols along two edges of the grid in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「庞纳特方格」沿方格两条边列出等位基因符号。

examples.en: We read the Punnett square as a diagram of possible outcomes for the fictional family.
examples.zh: 我们将「庞纳特方格」作为展示虚构家系可能结果的图来阅读。

words.enDefinition: An allele whose associated phenotype is expressed in a heterozygote under the stated dominance model.

examples.en: The dominant allele determines the shown category in the worksheet's simple heterozygous example with complete dominance.
examples.zh: 练习的完全显性简例中，「显性等位基因」决定杂合个体所显示的类别。

examples.en: We identified the dominant allele using the rule stated for the fictional trait in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据虚构性状所给定的规则识别「显性等位基因」。

collocations: trait associated with a dominant allele

words.enDefinition: An allele whose associated phenotype is masked by a dominant allele in a heterozygote for the trait.

examples.en: In the simplified model, a recessive allele is present in some entries without the recessive phenotype.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，某些未表现隐性表型的项目仍有「隐性等位基因」。

examples.en: We traced the recessive allele across the fictional family even where the feature was absent.
examples.zh: 即使可见特征没有表现，我们仍在虚构家系里追踪「隐性等位基因」。

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which the heterozygote has the same studied phenotype as one homozygous genotype.

examples.en: Complete dominance gives the two labelled genotypes the same observable category in the simplified exercise.
examples.zh: 在简化练习中，「完全显性」使两种标记基因型表现为同一可观察类别。

examples.en: We applied complete dominance only because the worksheet explicitly stated it for the fictional trait.
examples.zh: 由于练习明确给虚构性状设定了「完全显性」，我们才用了这一规则。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of a trait associated with one copy of a dominant allele at an autosomal locus.

examples.en: The worksheet models autosomal dominant inheritance using a numbered chromosome and one labelled allele copy.
examples.zh: 练习用编号的染色体和一份带标记的等位基因展示「常染色体显性遗传」。

examples.en: We identified autosomal dominant inheritance from the stated rules in the fictional family exercise.
examples.zh: 我们依据虚构家系练习的给定规则识别「常染色体显性遗传」。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of a trait expressed when both copies of an autosomal gene have relevant recessive variants.

examples.en: The exercise uses autosomal recessive inheritance to explain why two labelled copies are needed in this model.
examples.zh: 练习用「常染色体隐性遗传」说明为什么此模型中需要两份带标记的副本。

examples.en: We followed autosomal recessive inheritance across the three generations drawn for the fictional family.
examples.zh: 我们沿虚构家系图的三代追踪「常染色体隐性遗传」。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance involving a locus on the X chromosome.

examples.en: X-linked inheritance concerns the locus drawn on the X chromosome in our fictional example.
examples.zh: 「X 连锁遗传」涉及虚构示例中画在 X 染色体上的位点。

examples.en: We labelled X-linked inheritance before comparing the diagrams that apply different dominance assumptions.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「X 连锁遗传」，再比较采用不同显隐性假设的图示。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance in which an associated phenotype can be expressed with a single copy of a dominant allele on X.

examples.en: The classroom chart describes X-linked dominant inheritance using a fictional allele on the X chromosome.
examples.zh: 课堂图利用 X 染色体上的虚构等位基因描述「X 连锁显性遗传」。

examples.en: We compared X-linked dominant inheritance with the other X-linked pattern shown in the teaching table.
examples.zh: 我们把「X 连锁显性遗传」与教学表里的另一种 X 连锁模式作比较。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance involving a recessive allele on X that can be expressed when no contrasting dominant copy masks it.

examples.en: The lesson uses X-linked recessive inheritance to interpret the symbols in a fictional chromosome complement.
examples.zh: 课程用「X 连锁隐性遗传」解释虚构染色体组合中的符号。

examples.en: We applied the stated copy rules for X-linked recessive inheritance in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型里应用「X 连锁隐性遗传」的给定副本规则。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of variants at loci in regions unique to the Y chromosome.

examples.en: The example of Y-linked inheritance follows a labelled locus unique to the modelled Y chromosome.
examples.zh: 「Y 连锁遗传」示例追踪模型中 Y 染色体特有的一个标记位点。

examples.en: We used the chromosome labels to recognise Y-linked inheritance in the simplified family diagram.
examples.zh: 我们根据染色体标签，在简化家系图里辨认出「Y 连锁遗传」。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of mitochondrial genetic material, which in humans usually follows the maternal line.

examples.en: The mitochondrial inheritance diagram follows the small genome shown inside mitochondria in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中的「线粒体遗传」追踪画在线粒体内的小型基因组。

examples.en: We compared mitochondrial inheritance with transmission of a numbered chromosome in the teaching exercise.
examples.zh: 在教学练习中，我们将「线粒体遗传」与编号染色体的遗传传递作比较。

words.enDefinition: An individual who carries a recessive variant without showing its associated phenotype in the inheritance model.

examples.en: The genetic carrier in the exercise has one labelled allele without the corresponding recessive feature.
examples.zh: 练习中的「隐性变异携带者」有一份带标记的等位基因，但没有表现相应的隐性特征。

examples.en: We identified a genetic carrier using the explicit symbols in the fictional family chart.
examples.zh: 我们根据虚构家系图中的明确标记辨认一名「隐性变异携带者」。

words.enDefinition: An individual who must carry a specified allele under the stated inheritance assumptions and family relationships.

examples.en: The worksheet labels one fictional person an obligate carrier under the stated rules for the model.
examples.zh: 在模型给定规则下，练习将一名虚构人物标为「必然携带者」。

examples.en: We checked which assumptions support the obligate carrier label in this simplified classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们核查哪些假设支持课堂简图中的「必然携带者」标记。

collocations: identify an obligate carrier in a pedigree

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing relationships and the distribution of a genetic trait or variant across generations.

examples.en: The pedigree chart uses lines to link relatives in the fictional three-generation classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂三代虚构示例的「家系图」用线连接亲属。

examples.en: We read the pedigree chart from its first generation before looking at the trait symbols.
examples.zh: 我们从第一代开始读「家系图」，再看性状符号。

words.enDefinition: A mark used in a pedigree to represent an individual or information about that individual.

examples.en: The pedigree symbol is shaded for the fictional person with the feature defined in the legend.
examples.zh: 对于具备图例所定义特征的虚构人物，图中将其「家系图符号」涂色。

examples.en: We checked each pedigree symbol against the key before reading the family relationships in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先对照图例核对各个「家系图符号」，再读亲属关系。

words.enDefinition: The key explaining the shapes, marks, and colours used in a particular pedigree chart.

examples.en: The pedigree legend explains what the shaded and unshaded symbols mean in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 「家系图图例」解释虚构示例中涂色与未涂色符号的含义。

examples.en: We checked the pedigree legend before reading the labels beside the second generation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对「家系图图例」，再看第二代旁的标签。

words.enDefinition: A label identifying a row or generation in a pedigree, conventionally written with Roman numerals.

examples.en: The generation number appears at the left of each row in the fictional family diagram.
examples.zh: 虚构家系图的每行左侧都列出「世代编号」。

examples.en: We used the generation number and the individual's position to find the specified symbol.
examples.zh: 我们根据「世代编号」和个体位置找到指定符号。

words.enDefinition: The individual through whom a family first comes to attention for a genetics study or investigation.

examples.en: The arrow points to the proband in the fictional pedigree on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的虚构家系图上，箭头指向「先证者」。

examples.en: We located the proband before identifying the relatives shown on either side of the chart.
examples.zh: 我们先找到「先证者」，再辨认图表两侧所示的亲属。

words.enDefinition: An individual in a pedigree whose parents are not represented in that pedigree.

examples.en: The pedigree founder appears without parental symbols above in the simplified classroom family chart.
examples.zh: 在简化课堂家系图上，「家系始祖」上方没有亲代符号。

examples.en: We identified each pedigree founder as defined by the boundaries of the fictional chart.
examples.zh: 我们根据虚构图的范围，辨别各「家系始祖」。

words.enDefinition: The group of siblings sharing the same recorded parents within a pedigree.

examples.en: The sibship is drawn under one pair of parental symbols in the fictional pedigree.
examples.zh: 在这张虚构家系图上，「同胞组」画在同一对亲代符号下方。

examples.en: We counted the members of the sibship before comparing their labels in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先数「同胞组」内成员，再比较练习图中的各个标签。

words.enDefinition: A chain of parent-to-offspring relationships connecting an ancestor to later descendants in a pedigree.

examples.en: The line of descent links the top row to one branch of the fictional family.
examples.zh: 「世代传承线」把最上面一行与虚构家系的一个分支连接起来。

examples.en: We traced the line of descent through successive generations on the classroom family chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂家系图上逐代追踪「世代传承线」。

collocations: line of descent in a pedigree

words.enDefinition: A generation in a pedigree where a trait is unobserved between generations in which it appears.

examples.en: The skipped generation is unshaded between two shaded entries in the fictional classroom pedigree.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构家系图中，两个涂色项目之间是「未表现性状的一代」，因此未涂色。

examples.en: We compared the skipped generation with the allele labels retained in the fictional family model.
examples.zh: 我们把「未表现性状的一代」与虚构家系模型中保留的等位基因标记作对照。

words.enDefinition: A trait influenced by a locus on a sex chromosome.

examples.en: The example labels a sex-linked trait because its locus is placed on the X chromosome.
examples.zh: 因为示例位点画在 X 染色体上，示例将该性状标为「伴性性状」。

examples.en: We traced the sex-linked trait through the fictional family diagram using the given allele symbols.
examples.zh: 我们利用给定等位基因符号，在虚构家系图中追踪「伴性性状」。

words.enDefinition: A trait expressed in individuals of only one sex even though its alleles can be present in others.

examples.en: The sex-limited trait appears in one group even though both groups can carry its fictional allele.
examples.zh: 虚构等位基因可在两组中都存在，但「限性性状」只在一组表现。

examples.en: We compared the sex-limited trait with the chromosome-linked feature in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂表中比较「限性性状」与染色体连锁的特征。

words.enDefinition: A trait whose expression varies with sex-related biology even when the genotype is the same.

examples.en: The sex-influenced trait differs between the modelled groups despite their matching genotype labels in this exercise.
examples.zh: 本练习的模型组虽然基因型标签相同，「从性性状」的表现却不同。

examples.en: We used a fictional sex-influenced trait to separate expression patterns from the location of the gene.
examples.zh: 我们用虚构「从性性状」区分表型表达模式与基因所在位置。

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which the heterozygous phenotype is intermediate between the two homozygous phenotypes for the studied trait.

examples.en: The model uses incomplete dominance to show an intermediate value between the two labelled categories.
examples.zh: 模型用「不完全显性」演示位于两个标记类别之间的中间值。

examples.en: We identified incomplete dominance in the fictional illustration using the three resulting phenotype labels.
examples.zh: 我们根据虚构插图中的三个表型标签，辨认出「不完全显性」。

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which the effects of both alleles can be observed in a heterozygote.

examples.en: The codominance example shows both labelled features in a fictional individual with two different alleles.
examples.zh: 「共显性」示例的虚构人物有两种不同等位基因，并同时表现两个标记特征。

examples.en: We used the trait labels to distinguish codominance from an intermediate phenotype in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用性状标签区分「共显性」与中间表型。

words.enDefinition: More than two alternative forms of the same locus across a population.

examples.en: The fictional population has multiple alleles at the locus even though each person has two copies.
examples.zh: 虚构群体的该位点具有「复等位基因」，而每个个体只有两份副本。

examples.en: We counted the symbols representing multiple alleles across the full classroom table of genotypes.
examples.zh: 我们统计课堂整张基因型表里表示「复等位基因」的不同符号。

words.enDefinition: The tendency of loci close together on the same chromosome to be inherited together more often.

examples.en: Genetic linkage explains why the two fictional markers often appear together in the classroom inheritance table.
examples.zh: 「遗传连锁」解释了为什么课堂遗传表上的两个虚构标记常一起出现。

examples.en: We compared genetic linkage with independent assortment using two symbolic chromosome drawings in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用两幅符号染色体图比较「遗传连锁」与自由组合。

words.enDefinition: The small set of genetic material found inside mitochondria.

examples.en: The mitochondrial genome appears as a labelled circle outside the nucleus in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「线粒体基因组」画成细胞核外一个带标签的圆环。

examples.en: We compared the mitochondrial genome with the much larger nuclear genome in the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 我们比较教材图中的「线粒体基因组」与大得多的核基因组。

words.enDefinition: A difference in genetic material relative to a stated reference or another copy at the same location.

examples.en: The genetic variant is shown only as a different symbol at the same classroom locus.
examples.zh: 在课堂同一个位点上，「遗传变异」只用一个不同符号表示。

examples.en: We recorded the genetic variant separately from the displayed trait in the fictional worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构练习图里，将「遗传变异」与所显示的性状分开记录。

words.enDefinition: A genetic variant passed to an individual from one or both parents.

examples.en: The inherited variant has the same label in two generations of the fictional family chart.
examples.zh: 虚构家系图的两代人物中，「遗传而来的变异」用同一个标签。

examples.en: We traced the inherited variant along the connecting lines drawn on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂练习纸上的连线追踪「遗传而来的变异」。

words.enDefinition: A variant newly arising in the individual or in a parental reproductive cell, rather than inherited as an established variant in a parent.

examples.en: The de novo variant is represented by a new symbol in one branch of the fictional diagram.
examples.zh: 在虚构示意图的一个分支里，「新发变异」用新符号表示。

examples.en: We distinguished the de novo variant from the symbol shown in the previous generation.
examples.zh: 我们将「新发变异」与前一代显示的符号区分开。

collocations: arise as a de novo variant
example of a de novo variant

words.enDefinition: A variant present in the reproductive cell lineage that can potentially be passed to offspring.

examples.en: The germline variant is drawn within the reproductive cell lineage in the simplified classroom figure.
examples.zh: 课堂简图把「生殖系变异」画在生殖细胞谱系内。

examples.en: We compared a germline variant with a body-cell change using two fictional cell diagrams.
examples.zh: 我们用两幅虚构细胞图比较「生殖系变异」和体细胞中的变化。

collocations: potential transmission of a germline variant

words.enDefinition: A genetic variant arising in a body cell lineage outside the reproductive germ line.

examples.en: The somatic variant is marked in one branch of the fictional body cell lineage chart.
examples.zh: 虚构体细胞谱系图在一个分支里标出了「体细胞变异」。

examples.en: We followed the somatic variant through its labelled descendant cells in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂示意图带标记的后代细胞追踪「体细胞变异」。

collocations: somatic variant in a cell lineage

words.enDefinition: The presence of two or more genetically different cell populations derived from a single fertilized egg.

examples.en: The worksheet uses mosaicism to explain why the two clusters of model cells carry different symbols.
examples.zh: 练习用「嵌合现象」解释为什么两簇模型细胞的符号不同。

examples.en: We illustrated mosaicism by marking the cell groups that arose from the same original cell.
examples.zh: 我们标记来自同一个初始细胞的细胞组，以说明「嵌合现象」。

words.enDefinition: A difference in the number of copies of a genomic segment relative to another genome or reference.

examples.en: The copy number variation is shown as a different count of blocks in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图用积木块数目的差别表示「拷贝数变异」。

examples.en: We counted the blocks before labelling copy number variation on the fictional chromosome drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先数清积木块，再在虚构染色体图上标出「拷贝数变异」。

collocations: copy number variation of a genomic segment

words.enDefinition: The absence of a chromosome segment relative to its corresponding reference structure.

examples.en: The chromosomal deletion appears as a missing coloured block in the simplified diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂用的简化图把「染色体缺失」画成少了一块彩色区段。

examples.en: We identified a chromosomal deletion by comparing the two fictional diagrams with the reference drawing.
examples.zh: 我们将两张虚构图与参考图对照，找出「染色体缺失」。

collocations: segment absent in a chromosomal deletion

words.enDefinition: The presence of an extra copy of part of a chromosome relative to its reference structure.

examples.en: The chromosomal duplication is represented by a repeated labelled block in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，一个带标签的区段重复出现，表示「染色体重复」。

examples.en: We marked the chromosomal duplication before counting how many copies of the block are shown.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「染色体重复」，再数图中带有几份该区段的副本。

collocations: extra copy in a chromosomal duplication

words.enDefinition: A rearrangement in which a chromosome segment has the reverse orientation relative to its reference structure.

examples.en: The chromosomal inversion changes the order of the marked coloured blocks in the supplied diagram.
examples.zh: 给定图中，「染色体倒位」改变了标记彩色区段的顺序。

examples.en: We recognised the chromosomal inversion by following the two arrows that show opposite orientations in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿表示相反朝向的两支箭头辨认出「染色体倒位」。

words.enDefinition: A rearrangement in which a chromosome segment is moved to a different location, commonly on another chromosome.

examples.en: The chromosomal translocation is represented by a labelled block appearing on another chromosome in the model.
examples.zh: 模型用一个标记区段出现在另一条染色体上来表示「染色体易位」。

examples.en: We compared the chromosomal translocation with the reversed segment shown in the separate classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们把「染色体易位」与另一幅课堂图所示的倒转区段进行对比。

words.enDefinition: An abnormal chromosome complement with one or more individual chromosomes extra or missing, rather than a change in whole sets.

examples.en: The aneuploidy example shows an extra chromosome while the other groups in the synthetic diagram are unchanged.
examples.zh: 「非整倍性」示例显示多出一条染色体，合成图里的其他分组不变。

examples.en: We distinguished aneuploidy from a change involving whole chromosome sets in the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中，将「非整倍性」与整套染色体数目变化区分开。

words.enDefinition: The presence of one copy of a particular chromosome when two copies would normally be expected.

examples.en: The synthetic diagram uses monosomy for the numbered group containing only one chromosome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂合成图中，只有一条染色体的编号组用来表示「单体性」。

examples.en: We counted the chromosome copies before choosing the monosomy label on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先数染色体副本，再在练习纸上选用「单体性」标签。

words.enDefinition: The presence of three copies of a particular chromosome when two would normally be expected.

examples.en: The classroom trisomy example shows three copies in one group of the synthetic chromosome chart.
examples.zh: 在课堂的「三体性」示例里，合成染色体图的某个编号组有三份副本。

examples.en: We identified trisomy by counting the copies in one numbered set of the fictional diagram.
examples.zh: 我们统计虚构图某个编号组的副本数，以辨认「三体性」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of individuals with a specified genotype who show its associated phenotype under stated conditions.

examples.en: The penetrance depends on how many fictional individuals with the label display the stated feature.
examples.zh: 「外显率」取决于带该标签的虚构人物中有多少表现给定特征。

examples.en: We calculated penetrance using the genotype group defined in the synthetic table for class.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂合成表规定的基因型群组计算「外显率」。

words.enDefinition: A situation in which only some individuals with a genotype show the associated phenotype.

examples.en: The reduced penetrance example has matching genotypes but different records of whether the trait is present.
examples.zh: 「外显不全」示例里的基因型相同，性状是否出现的记录却不同。

examples.en: We marked reduced penetrance because some people with the model genotype did not show the feature.
examples.zh: 我们标出「外显不全」，因为具有模型给定基因型的部分人物未表现该特征。

words.enDefinition: Differences in degree or form of a phenotype among individuals who show it and share a genotype.

examples.en: The worksheet shows variable expressivity through different degrees of the same fictional trait in one group.
examples.zh: 练习用同一组中虚构性状的不同表现程度展示「可变表现度」。

examples.en: We distinguished variable expressivity from whether the example feature appeared at all in the table.
examples.zh: 我们把「可变表现度」与表里示例特征是否出现区分开。

words.enDefinition: A trait influenced by genetic variation at more than one locus.

examples.en: The worksheet represents a polygenic trait with several labelled loci contributing to the modelled measurement.
examples.zh: 练习用多个标记位点共同影响模型测量值表示「多基因性状」。

examples.en: We compared a polygenic trait with the single-locus example on the preceding page.
examples.zh: 我们将「多基因性状」与前一页的单位点示例作比较。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic shaped by a combination of genetic and non-genetic influences.

examples.en: The model of a multifactorial trait includes both genetic contributions and differing environments in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「多因素性状」模型包括遗传影响和环境差异。

examples.en: We described a multifactorial trait after comparing the two kinds of influence on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习纸上的两类影响后，描述了「多因素性状」。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic measured numerically along a scale instead of grouped solely into named categories.

examples.en: The quantitative trait is represented by a numerical measurement for each fictional person in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，每名虚构人物各有一个数值测量结果来表示「数量性状」。

examples.en: We plotted the quantitative trait on a continuous scale for the synthetic dataset in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把合成数据中的「数量性状」绘在一条连续数轴上。

words.enDefinition: A difference in how strongly or in which direction an environmental change affects different genotypes.

examples.en: The genotype-environment interaction appears when the two modelled genotypes respond differently across the fictional settings.
examples.zh: 两个模型基因型对不同虚构环境表现出不同反应时，就出现「基因型与环境互作」。

examples.en: We drew separate lines to illustrate the genotype-environment interaction in the synthetic classroom plot.
examples.zh: 我们在合成课堂图中分别画出两条线，以说明「基因型与环境互作」。

words.enDefinition: An interaction in which variation at one locus modifies the phenotypic effect of variation at another.

examples.en: The model illustrates epistasis when one labelled locus changes how the second locus affects the fictional trait.
examples.zh: 模型中，一个标记位点改变另一位点对虚构性状的影响，以此说明「上位效应」。

examples.en: We identified epistasis after comparing the effect of each locus in different model genotypes.
examples.zh: 我们比较不同模型基因型中各位点的效应后，识别出「上位效应」。

words.enDefinition: The influence of one gene on more than one phenotypic characteristic.

examples.en: The pleiotropy diagram connects one fictional locus to both measured features on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的「一因多效」图把一个虚构位点同时连接到两项实测特征。

examples.en: We distinguished pleiotropy from several genes contributing to one feature in the example table.
examples.zh: 我们在示例表里将「一因多效」与多个基因影响一个特征区分开。

words.enDefinition: A form of parent-of-origin-dependent gene expression in which the parental origin influences which allele is active.

examples.en: The genomic imprinting figure labels expression according to which parent supplied the fictional allele copy.
examples.zh: 「基因组印记」图根据虚构等位基因副本来自哪一方亲代来标记表达情况。

examples.en: We compared genomic imprinting with a model where the labels depend only on the variant itself.
examples.zh: 我们将「基因组印记」与仅由变异本身决定标签的模型比较。

collocations: parent of origin in genomic imprinting

words.enDefinition: The proportion of all counted copies at a locus represented by a particular allele.

examples.en: The allele frequency uses the total number of copies at the locus as its denominator.
examples.zh: 「等位基因频率」用该位点的副本总数作为分母。

examples.en: We calculated allele frequency from the symbolic counts in the synthetic classroom dataset.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂合成数据里的符号计数计算「等位基因频率」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of individuals in a defined group who have a particular genotype.

examples.en: The genotype frequency uses individuals as the denominator in the fictional population table for class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构群体表中的「基因型频率」以个体总数作为分母。

examples.en: We compared genotype frequency with the fraction of allele copies in the same exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「基因型频率」与同一练习中计算的等位基因副本比例作比较。

words.enDefinition: A reference equilibrium in which allele and genotype frequencies remain stable across generations under specified assumptions.

examples.en: The Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium example compares expected and observed genotype proportions in the fictional population.
examples.zh: 「哈迪—温伯格平衡」示例比较虚构群体的预期与观测基因型比例。

examples.en: We listed the assumptions of Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium before interpreting the calculated classroom proportions.
examples.zh: 我们先列出「哈迪—温伯格平衡」的假设，再解读课堂算出的比例。

words.enDefinition: Change in allele frequencies across generations due to chance sampling in a finite population.

examples.en: The genetic drift simulation starts with the same frequencies but gives different outcomes across repeated runs.
examples.zh: 「遗传漂变」模拟从相同频率开始，每次重复运行则可能得到不同结果。

examples.en: We compared genetic drift in two fictional populations using randomly selected paper symbols.
examples.zh: 我们随机抽取纸片上的符号，比较两个虚构群体中的「遗传漂变」。

collocations: genetic drift in a finite population

words.enDefinition: A form of genetic drift in which a new population begins with allele frequencies reflecting a small founding group.

examples.en: The founder effect model compares symbolic allele counts in the founding group with the larger original group.
examples.zh: 「奠基者效应」模型比较创始小组与原先较大群体的等位基因符号计数。

examples.en: We used paper symbols to simulate the founder effect in a completely fictional population.
examples.zh: 我们用纸片符号模拟完全虚构群体中的「奠基者效应」。

collocations: allele frequencies after a founder effect

words.enDefinition: A marked reduction in population size that leaves later generations descended from a smaller subset of individuals.

examples.en: The population bottleneck is shown as a sharp drop in the synthetic population size chart.
examples.zh: 合成群体规模图中，「群体瓶颈」表现为规模骤降。

examples.en: We compared diversity before and after the population bottleneck in the fictional classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 我们比较虚构课堂模拟里「群体瓶颈」前后的遗传多样性。

collocations: genetic diversity after a population bottleneck

words.enDefinition: The movement of alleles between populations when individuals or their descendants contribute to another population's gene pool.

examples.en: The gene flow model uses arrows to show allele contributions between the two fictional populations.
examples.zh: 「基因流」模型用箭头展示两个虚构群体之间的等位基因贡献。

examples.en: We compared gene flow with chance changes within one isolated model population in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「基因流」与单个孤立模型群体内部随机发生的变化作了比较。

collocations: compare gene flow and genetic drift

words.enDefinition: The proportion of variation in a trait within a population attributed to genetic differences under specified conditions.

examples.en: The heritability estimate applies to variation across the fictional population under the conditions stated in class.
examples.zh: 「遗传力」估计适用于课堂给定条件下虚构群体中性状的变异。

examples.en: We compared heritability across two model populations with different sources of variation in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习中变异来源不同的两个模型群体的「遗传力」。
